Use Malbit together

  1. Open this page in Chrome if possible. Put the screen where your friend can see it.
  2. Choose the language you’ll speak, select Start microphone, and allow access.
  3. Speak in short phrases. Captions may change until the phrase is complete.

Expand the caption view for larger text. You can also type a message.

Speech and translation providers

Your browser may send audio to its speech recognition service. Chrome uses on-device translation when the language pack is ready. Otherwise, Malbit sends text to MyMemory for translation. MyMemory has a free daily limit. Malbit stores captions in this open tab. MyMemory terms

The translation appears on the caption screen.
